around.headline: Traffic diversions and a liquor ban in parts of Bengaluru today for the Eid Milad-un-Nabi procession
around.summary: Police have put route diversions and curbs on heavy vehicles in place for today's Milad-un-Nabi procession, and liquor sale is banned in parts of the city for the day, per today's reports. Check the diversion map before driving through the city centre and don't expect to buy alcohol in the affected areas today.

around.headline: Speeding car kills scooter rider, damages three more vehicles in signal-side crash at Kaggadasapura
around.summary: A speeding car rammed a scooter at a Kaggadasapura signal, killing the rider — a hairstylist — and damaging three other vehicles in the pile-up; the driver has been arrested, per today's reports. If you're on a two-wheeler, glance at your mirrors while stopped at a signal so a fast car doesn't catch you off guard.

around.headline: Food safety crackdown flags 10 premium Bengaluru clubs, including KSCA, Bowring and Century Club
around.summary: FDA inspections found cockroaches and filth at several of the city's well-known clubs, flagging 10 of them for hygiene violations, per today's reports. Being an expensive or exclusive venue is no guarantee of kitchen hygiene — check the FSSAI licence display and don't hesitate to ask about their last inspection rating.
around.source: NDTV, The Times of India, The New Indian Express

around.headline: Karnataka government says no RRTS corridors approved yet, two months after Shivakumar's push
around.summary: The state government has clarified that no Regional Rapid Transit System corridors have actually been approved, despite Deputy CM Shivakumar's push two months ago, per today's report. Don't plan your commute around RRTS timelines just yet — it's still at the proposal stage.

around.headline: Minister red-flags DK Shivakumar's Bengaluru residential parking-fee proposal
around.summary: Karnataka minister Ramalinga Reddy has urged the CM to reconsider a proposed parking fee on Bengaluru residents, calling it a burden on citizens, per today's reports. Worth watching if you park on the street near home — the fee isn't final yet.

around.headline: Six held for killing medical shop owner on Madiwala Main Road
around.summary: Police have arrested six people over the daylight killing of a shop owner on Madiwala Main Road earlier this week, per today's report. CCTV and witness footage were what turned this into a quick arrest.

around.headline: US H-1B visa fee hike proposal threatens to shut out Indian students and workers
around.summary: A proposed hike in US H-1B visa fees could make it significantly costlier for Indian tech workers and students to move for jobs abroad, per today's report. With Bengaluru's large IT workforce, this is worth watching if you or someone in your team is weighing an onsite move.

street_smart.title: You run a small shop and just switched to accepting UPI payments by QR code. A customer pays, shows you a loud 'payment successful' chime from their phone, and walks off with the goods before you've actually checked your own bank app or SMS for the credit. What should you have done differently, and what's the trap to watch for going forward?
street_smart.based_on: No single incident in today's feeds; this rotates in from the evergreen list (UPI fraud & fake payment screenshots), which hasn't come up in this brief's last three weeks — chosen instead of a news-based scenario since none of today's Bengaluru stories centred on a scam or road/consumer incident with a clear decision point.
street_smart.situation: It's a busy hour, there's a small queue behind the customer, and your phone is in your apron pocket rather than in your hand.

choices.text: Always confirm the credit yourself in your bank's app or via the SMS/notification before handing over goods — never rely on a sound or screen the customer shows you.
choices.feedback: Correct — the only proof of payment that matters is the money actually showing up in your account. Fraudsters use lookalike apps that play a realistic 'payment successful' tone and even show a fake success screen without any real transaction happening.

choices.text: Trust the payment confirmation sound/screen the customer shows you, since most customers are honest and you don't want to hold up the queue.
choices.feedback: This is the trap — the sound and on-screen 'success' message can both be faked by apps built specifically to mimic UPI payment confirmations. By the time you check your real balance, the customer and the goods are gone.

choices.text: Ask the customer to pay cash instead, since UPI feels too risky to deal with.
choices.feedback: This avoids the specific trap but isn't a real fix — you'll lose UPI-preferring customers, and cash carries its own risks (counterfeit notes, theft). The actual fix is a 10-second verification habit, not abandoning UPI.

choices.text: Check your phone only at the end of the day when reconciling total sales.
choices.feedback: By then you can't tell which specific customer's payment didn't go through, and you've already handed over goods for free. Verify at the point of sale, not after the fact.

takeaways: A payment sound or on-screen message on the customer's phone is not proof — only your own bank app, SMS, or a dedicated merchant device showing the credit counts.
Periodically inspect your printed QR code sticker for signs of tampering or a sticker pasted over yours — a swapped QR code silently redirects every payment to a fraudster's account.
If a payment genuinely fails to arrive, ask the customer to show the debit confirmation from their own bank app (not just the UPI app's status page) before assuming it's a technical delay.

quiz.question: What caused today's deadly crash at Bengaluru's Kaggadasapura signal?
options: A bus skidded on a wet road
A speeding car rammed a scooter and hit three more vehicles
A traffic signal malfunction caused a pile-up
A pothole threw a rider off balance
quiz.why: The driver has been arrested, per today's reports — the scooter rider, a hairstylist, died in the crash.

quiz.question: How many premium Bengaluru clubs were flagged in the FDA's recent food safety crackdown?
quiz.why: KSCA, Bowring Club and Century Club were among the 10 clubs flagged for hygiene violations including cockroaches and filth.

quiz.question: The proposed US H-1B visa fee hike is expected to primarily affect which group, per today's report?
options: Indian tech workers and students seeking to work in the US
quiz.why: India accounts for a large share of H-1B visa holders, so a fee hike would disproportionately raise costs for Indian tech workers and students.

quiz.question: Which Indian river primarily supplies Bengaluru's drinking water, despite the city being over 100 km away from it?
quiz.why: Water is pumped uphill from the Cauvery via the Torekadanahalli (TK Halli) pumping station, one of the most energy-intensive water supply systems in India.

quiz.question: In the Indian Constitution, what is the minimum age required to become a member of the Lok Sabha?
quiz.why: The minimum age for the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) is higher, at 30 years.
